cc:Work.dc:title: Nearly every large ship that enters reaches Mobile: 495 at the port, 55 km in, against 475 counted at the entrance
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the Mobile Bay route cells shaded by distinct large ships, and a step chart of ships against distance from the entrance; 475 ships at the entrance and 495 at Mobile.
